title: Will the wall mount work with my old portable charger?
text:
Will the wall mount work with my old portable charger?

No, this wall mount is designed specifically for the Ather Duo charger.

title: Does it come with the scooter or do I have to buy it separately?
text:
Does it come with the scooter or do I have to buy it separately?

The Ather Duo charger comes as a part of the standard 450X high range kit. The wall mount can be purchased as an accessory. Purchasers of other Ather models have the option to purchase both, this charger and this wall mount as an accessory.

title: Can I upgrade to the Ather Duo charger if I have a 350W charger?
text:
Can I upgrade to the Ather Duo charger if I have a 350W charger?

Yes you can purchase the Ather Duo bundle for Rs 14,999 for the complete Ather Duo experience.

title: Can I buy the charger and the wall mount separately?
text:
Can I buy the charger and the wall mount separately?

Yes, you can purchase each individually.

title: How long does it take to charge the Ather 450S?
text:
How long does it take to charge the Ather 450S?

Home charging: 0-80% in 6 hr 36 min | 0-100% in 8 hr 36 min Fast charging speed at Ather Grid™ is the same as the Ather 450X.
